overclaims: Listing approaches does not establish their effectiveness or whether they offer comprehensive safety comparable to Constitutional AI.

The e7 excerpt is cut down to the fragment "simple subtasks" instead of the full sentence, so it doesn't show what it is cited for. Axis, horizon, outcome and dates are correct.
